unresolvedReferences.description: The clause 辛未遷 (transferred on the xinwei day) has no stated subject; it follows 姚文然's eleventh-month transfer and precedes 黃道行's replacement, and may be a textual corruption.

The clause 四月乙未遷 (transferred on the yiwei day of the fourth month) has no stated subject; it follows 吳涵's retirement (致仕) in the third month and precedes 梅鋗's appointment, so its referent is unclear and it is not attributed to anyone.

The clause 十二月加尚書銜 (granted ministerial rank in the twelfth month) has no stated subject; it is tentatively attributed to 特古忒 (last named in the cell) with uncertain certainty, but could refer to 拉都渾.
In 王允禩 the leading 王 may be a surname or a princely title (prince) before the name 允禩; the packet does not settle which, so the full string is kept as written.
